auth_details: API key via the x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY header (HTTP/GraphQL). WebSocket uses ?key= query param.
free_tier_limits: Application-based free Open Access for pre-revenue startups, students, independent developers, researchers, and fans; limited API calls; CS2/Dota 2 historical (not full commercial live feeds).
paid_plans: Commercial (betting/fantasy/media/other): contact sales for custom quote; no public list prices. Professional team portals free with premium add-ons.
example_request: curl -X POST "https://api-op.grid.gg/central-data/graphql" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"{ teams(filter: {name: {contains: \"Team\"}}) { edges { node { id name } } } }"}'
resolution_notes: base_url: auditor right for public OA—docs use https://api-op.grid.gg paths (central-data/graphql, live-data-feed/series-state/graphql); Full Access still https://api.grid.gg (https://docs.grid.gg/public/documentation/api-documentation/in-game-data/series-state). auth: auditor right—x-api-key not Bearer (https://docs.grid.gg/public/documentation/api-reference/getting-started/authentication). pricing: auditor right—free Open Access for qualifying non-commercial; commercial contact-sales (https://grid.gg/open-access/, https://grid.gg/get-access/). example: auditor right—POST GraphQL + x-api-key (https://blog.grid.gg/consuming-an-esports-graphql-api-using-javascript-2c99aa9b6fb8).
